## Research directions

The current notes focus on model adaptation, semantic ranking, calibrated decisions, and the distinction between a promising benchmark number and evidence strong enough to inform engineering decisions.

This is an independently maintained technical portfolio, not an open research lab. Questions and factual corrections are welcome through the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/anhnd3/research-portfolio); availability of underlying private data is not implied.
